titre: Reporting your separation to the Caf
resume: Report the separation online so your entitlements are recalculated on your income alone, and choose who receives the benefits in shared residence (Cerfa n° 14000).
aQuoiCaSert: After a separation, your benefits from the Caf (Caisse d'allocations familiales, the family benefits office), such as family allowances, housing benefit, the prime d'activité (in-work bonus) or the ASF (family support allowance), are recalculated without your ex-partner's income. Reporting the change quickly opens new entitlements and avoids having to repay overpayments. In shared residence, both parents must also tell the Caf who receives the benefits.
quiEstConcerne: Any Caf beneficiary who separates, whether they were married, in a PACS (civil partnership) or living together.
The ex-partner who was not the beneficiary and must open their own file to receive benefits.
Parents with shared residence, who must choose the beneficiary.
aSavoir: Shared residence, if you agree: the parents name a single beneficiary for all benefits, or split the family allowances in half and name a single beneficiary for the other benefits.
Shared residence, if you disagree: each parent automatically receives a share of the family allowances.
The choice can only be changed after one year (unless the child's residence changes), then it is renewed automatically.

Only the family allowances are split. Paje (prestation d'accueil du jeune enfant, early childhood benefit), complément familial (family supplement), housing benefit, AEEH (disabled child education allowance), ASF and ARS (back-to-school allowance) go to the designated parent. Exception: since December 1, 2025, in case of disagreement, each parent can receive the complément de libre choix du mode de garde (CMG, childcare allowance) according to their own situation.

Residence with one parent only, with no child support paid by the other: you may be entitled to the family support allowance (see the guide entry "Family support allowance (ASF, allocation de soutien familial)").

aConfirmer: In the overseas departments, family allowance rules differ from mainland France (paid from the first child according to several sources): the amount and how it is shared in shared residence with only one child should be confirmed with the Caf de la Martinique.
The Caf may ask for proof of separation if you still live under the same roof: the type of proof accepted is to be confirmed with the Caf.
To be confirmed locally: opening hours and appointment booking at the Caf de la Martinique reception desks.
